Question Choices: Find the direction angle of the vector (5, 0) in degrees. Measure counterclockwise from positive x and choose 0 <= theta < 360 degrees.
Hints: The vector points along the positive x-axis.|Measure from that axis.
Solution: For a nonzero vector, measure direction counterclockwise from positive x in [0,360) degrees. Use both component signs to choose the quadrant; arctan(y/x) alone cannot distinguish opposite quadrants and is undefined when x=0. Axis directions can be read directly. Use atan2(0,5) and the component signs: theta=0 degrees in [0,360).
